name: org_graph_split_unit
description: Split a unit into two or more new units from effective_on (today by default). The successors take the unit's level and parent. Each person placements names moves to their successor with the same role and allocation; anyone not named leaves, and shows as in no team if they have no other live unit. The unit retires, and everything shares one cause. A unit with live sub-units, or one an HRIS supplies, is refused.

plan_id.description: the plan whose change this applies. Refused unless you may apply that plan's changes

plan_change_id.description: the plan change this applies; needs plan_id

cause_id.description: groups this with the plan's other changes, to change back together; needs plan_id

successor_names.description: names of the new units, at least two, each different

placements.description: person_id => the name of the successor they move to, one of successor_names. Members left out end their membership, and those with no other live unit show as in no team.
